# CardTeur agent guide

This file's content has been consolidated into `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root, which is the actively maintained, canonical guide for this project — read that instead. It used to duplicate `CLAUDE.md` here, which let the two drift out of sync (e.g. this file still referenced a singular `/api/match` route and port-3000 test assumptions that were no longer true). Keeping this file as a thin pointer avoids that drift.

If you're a Copilot-based tool that auto-loads files under `.github/` but not `CLAUDE.md`, open `CLAUDE.md` manually before making changes in this repo.
